pricing: each leg at the chain's price_used (bid-ask mid where both are positive, else last, flagged); per share and on the position (shares × per-share; contracts = shares/100 noted)
stress: the book's loss in the three standing index scenarios (book.json) with the structure in place: the position's stressed price is spot × (1 + β_index × shock), the structure's payoff at that price less its net premium replaces the position's unhedged loss
